design.signal_weights: equal (mean of the available signal z-scores)
design.zscore: cross-sectional within each book every month, at least 3 instruments
design.selection: long top third, short bottom third of each book (n = floor(N/3) per side, N >= 3)
design.position_sizing: inverse of trailing annualised volatility (equal risk per position)

costs.basis: per unit of notional traded (one-way), charged at each rebalance

design.bond_return: excess return from monthly-average yields: (y - funding)/12 - D*dy + C*dy^2/2, D and C of a 10-year par bond; weights decided at the end of month t earn the change between the averages of t+1 and t+2 (avoids the look-ahead in month averages)
